constraints.name: ck_breach_response
constraints.sqltext: response is null or response in ('HOLD_TO_MATURITY','BREAK_EARLY','SEEK_RATIFICATION','REDUCE_ON_ROLL')

constraints.name: ck_exception_resolution
constraints.sqltext: resolution is null or resolution in ('RESIZED','REROUTED','OVERRIDDEN','CANCELLED','CORRECTED','CHALLENGED')

constraints.name: ck_hedge_unlink_reason
constraints.sqltext: unlink_reason is null or unlink_reason in ('ROLLED','CLOSED_EARLY','EXPOSURE_CANCELLED','REALLOCATED')

constraints.name: ck_rec_decision
constraints.sqltext: decision is null or decision in ('ACCEPTED','EDITED','REJECTED','EXPIRED')
